text: verdict parser v2, payment app (scripts/verdict.mjs decodeVerdict; port scripts/counts/verdict_parser.py): accepts (1) the whole response as one JSON object, (2) exactly one closed ```json or unlabelled code fence with prose around it, or (3) prose followed by one bare JSON object that ends the response (new in v2). The object needs exactly the keys status, reason, failedAssertion, status pass|fail|unresolved, no duplicate keys; the prose must hold no other explicit verdict ("status: pass", ...) and no other object with a status key. verdict parser v2, Moodle (adapters/moodle/verdict.mjs decodeStepVerdict, also labelled v2): accepts only (1) whole JSON or (2) one closed JSON/unlabelled fence with the same prose checks; there is no trailing-object form. Keys exactly status, reason, failingStep, failingStepText; a fail must give a 1-based step number and quote the step; the step is then verified against the listed step text and mapped to the Behat index.
